title: Learning guitar by watching Willie Bontong and Chris Kelly
summary: He learned chords by watching Willie Bontong in Chris Kelly's band, who showed him chords and let him sit in; he demonstrates on the guitar.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

Well, that's how I come to learn, by watching other fellas play. There used to be a fella by the name of Willie Bontong used to play with Chris Kelly long years ago, and he was a good guitar player. And wherever they played up, I used to go stand up by the bandstand and watch him. So he told me one time, he said, you like that instrument there? I said, yeah. So he said, well, I'm going to show you some chords on it. And he used to show me some chords on it while they were, in between, while they were playing. So finally, kept showing me that, and one night, Chris Kelly was playing, he said, I have a hall back out there, young men hall. And I was standing up by the stairs, so he said, come here. So I can't sit here until I come back.
